activities.name: School Robotics Team (Korean HS National Champion)

rationale.intuition: Korean applicants face significant intl penalty at Stanford. Stanford overall admit ~3.8%; intl admit ~8% per CDS but Korean cohort competes against very strong Korean STEM applicants (KMO/KPhO medalists, KAIST-track). GPA noted as Korean HS scale normalized to ~3.95 unweighted 4.0 (Korean HS uses internal 9-band system; top decile maps to ~3.9-4.0). Strong EE profile but RD (no early boost). Industry consensus: 2-7%.

sources.name: Stanford CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Overall admit 3.8%; intl ~12% of class. Korea is top-3 sending country alongside China/India.

sources.name: Crimson Korea Acceptance Report 2024
sources.evidence: Korean STEM applicants at Stanford RD cluster 2-6% in published case data; Korean HS GPA normalization handled at AO level.

sources.name: Compass Education Asia 2024 Benchmarks
sources.evidence: Korean applicants benefit slightly from KAIST research credibility but penalized by saturated Asian STEM bucket; RD has no early-round lift.
